name: Arrow Vase with Persian Inscriptions and Floral Scrolls
material: porcelain with underglaze cobalt blue decoration
dimensions: Diameter: 10.7 cm (4 3/16 in.); Overall: 26 cm (10 1/4 in.)
summary: Chinese potters in the 1500s integrated foreign motifs, shapes, and ideas in order to cater to changing tastes and new customers in an increasingly global world.
